## History

Minnie May is the younger sister of [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). When she fell dangerously ill with the croup, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) sought help at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) while their parents were away. [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) used her past experience with infants to treat Minnie May's croup throughout the night until a doctor arrived, successfully saving her life.

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--minnie-may.md)

Minnie May's life was saved by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) when she fell dangerously ill with croup while their parents were away. Drawing on her past experience caring for infants, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) successfully treated Minnie May throughout the night until a doctor arrived. This act of rescue earned [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) the gratitude of the [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) family and allowed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to resume their friendship.

- Saved by  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043)</sub>
